extracted.stage: Financial remedy proceedings in a divorce; client is the respondent
extracted.summary: A solicitor enquires about a £26,000 litigation loan for a divorce respondent in financial remedy proceedings where around £152,500 of property and pension assets are in dispute.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry on behalf of your client in these financial remedy proceedings. We have noted the £26,000 sought towards counsel, a forensic accountant and your own costs, and the approximately £152,500 of assets in dispute. To take this further we would need confirmation of the jurisdiction of the proceedings, the stage reached and any listed hearing dates, a breakdown of the costs to be funded, and details of the nature and ownership of the assets in dispute. Please also confirm your client's details and your firm's contact for the file. We will come back to you once we have had a chance to review the information.
